SELECT n.id, n.name, n.region, n.host, n.port, n.protocol, n.enabled, n.max_online AS maxOnline, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM vpn_session s WHERE s.node_id = n.id AND s.status = 'online') AS onlineCount FROM vpn_node n ORDER BY n.sort_no ASC, n.id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO vpn_node (name, region, host, port, user_id, protocol, network, security, header_type, host_header, tls, sni, path, alter_id, max_online, enabled, sort_no, remark, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{name}, #{region}, #{host}, #{port}, #{userId}, #{protocol}, #{network}, #{security}, #{headerType}, #{hostHeader}, #{tls}, #{sni}, #{path}, #{alterId}, #{maxOnline}, #{enabled}, #{sortNo}, #{remark}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE vpn_node SET name=#{name}, region=#{region}, host=#{host}, port=#{port}, user_id=#{userId}, protocol=#{protocol}, network=#{network}, security=#{security}, header_type=#{headerType}, host_header=#{hostHeader}, tls=#{tls}, sni=#{sni}, path=#{path}, alter_id=#{alterId}, max_online=#{maxOnline}, enabled=#{enabled}, sort_no=#{sortNo}, remark=#{remark}, updated_at=NOW() WHERE id=#{id}
UPDATE vpn_node SET enabled = #{enabled}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
